release_notes:
KLAM 3.7.3 Production Release
Multi-category Expense entry and batch posting
Individual Vendor/Payee and Note for each expense category
Alphabetical Income and Expense category ordering
Improved Expense entry layout and Note visibility
Controlled Opening Balance Reverse/Reset workflow
Opening Balance reversals retain full journal audit history
Reversed Opening Balances can be reopened and correctly finalized again
Additional Finance workflow and stability refinements.
